name: api-meubolso
description: API para gerenciamento financeiro com Supabase

scripts.package: npm ci --production && powershell Compress-Archive -Path api,src,package.json,package-lock.json,node_modules -DestinationPath meubolso-lambda.zip -Force && npm install
scripts.package:linux: npm ci --production && zip -r meubolso-lambda.zip api src package.json package-lock.json node_modules && npm install
